definition: to an extreme or exaggerated degree
description: A wedding party in a wooden barn strung with fairy lights. A young man in a light grey suit leaps high above the dance floor again and again, legs split out straight to each side, arms flung up, mouth wide open and tie flying, then lands and lunges forward with a shout. A pair of shoes lies on the floor. Beside him a couple embraces, a young woman in a lilac dress covers her mouth, the bride in white claps above her head and a man in green bends over laughing. A band plays behind.

en.question: What is the man in grey doing?
